items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: 'course I knew him before he was in school

ctx.x: But they didn't have a special price for them.

Well, after that, I went into the real estate business, and I stayed in that until '62, and then I retired, and I came home and I've written several songs and a lot of religious songs and "The Biddy Mason Story," "Stagecoach Mary," "Nightmare," "Three Passengers," and, oh, I don't know. I've got 'em around here. It... uh...but it seems like that I just couldn't find the right agent. I had agents, some of them I had a coupla years. They couldn't do nothing with it. I don't know, so I just got mad and called them…
